teaser: Ten at night, the amplifiers are still warm and the room smells of spilled coffee and cable dust. You are the one coiling cords nobody else notices need coiling. Life path 9 is called the Humanitarian, the number that asks a life to give itself away for something larger than any one person in it. ISFJ is the type built to notice what the room needs before it says so, and to supply it without being asked twice. Crossed together, the giving stops being occasional. It becomes the shape of an ordinary Tuesday, and the question becomes who notices when the one doing the giving runs low.
